name: smartdeal-ai
description: Automated gadget price comparison web app for India (Amazon India, Flipkart, and more)

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client run preview"
